name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Asks for a decision or a short input before the user moves on.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Optional element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`, so pass a Button).

props.name: alert
props.description: A `DialogAlert` shown under the body, for a side effect the user must know about.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions on the right of the footer. Leave it out for a read-only dialog.

props.name: footerStart
props.description: Figma's `footerSlot`: content on the left of the footer, e.g. a "Don't ask again" checkbox.

props.name: children
props.description: Body. A string renders as body text (13px, text/default).

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show the close button in the corner.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal blocks the page and shows the overlay; turn it off for inline previews.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Called when focus moves into the dialog on open; `preventDefault()` keeps it where it was.

DialogTrigger.description: Opens the dialog. With `asChild` it lends its behaviour to your own Button.

DialogContent.description: The overlay and the panel, portaled; the panel takes the header, body and footer as children.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Show the close button in the corner.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`; inside it the dialog centres on that element.

DialogHeader.description: The title and description, 16 / 16 / 8 in, clear of the close button.

DialogDescription.description: One line under the title, read out after it: body size, muted.

DialogBody.description: The content between header and footer; it scrolls when the dialog meets the screen's edge.

props.name: start
props.description: Content on the left (Figma's `footerSlot`), e.g. a "Don't ask again" checkbox.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows the close button; called when it is pressed.
